title: chore(github): add a security regression issue template
problem: There is no template for reporting a missed detection or a new false positive, so reports lack the details needed to add a fixture.
why: A structured template speeds the regression-test loop and improves rule quality.
scope: Add an issue template capturing rule id, minimal source, expected and actual behavior, and SDK version.
guidance: Reference the security policy for confidential reports.
acceptance: Template merged and listed in the issue chooser
tests: Manual check of the template form
security: Directs vulnerabilities to private reporting rather than public issues.

title: ci(release): automate release notes from the changelog
problem: Release notes are written by hand, which risks drift from the changelog.
why: Automation keeps the release page and changelog consistent.
scope: Extract the section for a tag from `CHANGELOG.md` and use it as the release body.
guidance: Fail the release if no matching section exists.
acceptance: Release workflow uses the changelog section

title: ci(release): build and test on aarch64 Linux
problem: CI covers x86_64 only, so ARM users and Apple-silicon container users are untested.
why: ARM is increasingly common for development and cloud.
scope: Add an aarch64 Linux build-and-test job (native or via cross).
guidance: Reuse the existing test command; document any platform-specific skips.

title: feat(observability): add structured logging with a log level
problem: Debugging a scan requires re-running with ad hoc prints because there is no leveled logging.
why: Structured, leveled logs on stderr improve supportability without touching machine output.
scope: Add `--log-level` emitting structured lines to stderr, disabled by default.
guidance: Keep stdout reserved for reports; never log secrets or absolute home paths.
tests: CLI test asserting stderr logging and clean stdout
security: Never log scanned source content or environment variables.
